top_findings.title: Season standings double-count every fixture for seasons 2012-2019 (overlapping Serie A datasets not deduplicated)
top_findings.evidence: data_loader.py:85-98 concatenates Brasileirao_Matches.csv (2012-2022) and novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv (2003-2019) without dedup; verified overlap = seasons 2012-2019, 380 duplicate fixtures each. server.py:176 filters competition via substring 'brasileirão', matching both 'Brasileirão Serie A' (data_loader.py:19) and 'Brasileirão Serie A (Histórico)' (data_loader.py:66). Reproduced: season_standings(2019) selects 760 rows and reports Flamengo 180 pts over 76 games (real 2019: 90 pts / 38 games). Ordering is preserved (uniform 2x) but points/W-D-L/GF-GA are doubled. tests/test_server.py:161-165 only asserts '2019' and 'pts' appear in the output, so the suite cannot catch this.
top_findings.suggestion: Deduplicate on (date, home_team_norm, away_team_norm) in get_matches(), or drop the 2012-2019 rows from one of the two Serie A sources; add a test asserting a known team's real season points (e.g. Flamengo 2019 = 90) and 38 games played.
